control_need.evidence: A good way to keep control of something more intelligent than you? We have almost no examples of that working.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: I genuinely don't know if we'll be okay. And I think anyone who claims certainty either way is overconfident.

trust_propensity.evidence: The worry is that once they get smarter than us, they'll figure out how to manipulate us. They'll have read all the books on how to do it.

risk_appetite.evidence: I don't think they should scale this up any more until they've understood whether they can control it.

self_efficacy.evidence: Backpropagation is the workhorse. I've been trying to break it for years and I couldn't find anything better.

autonomy_need.evidence: Look, the reason I left Google was so I could talk about the dangers without thinking about how it impacts Google.

intimacy_need.evidence: Winning the Turing Award with Yann and Yoshua — that felt like vindication for a whole community, not just us.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I'm not an expert on policy. I'm a scientist. But somebody has to say this out loud.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: I'm a scientist who thinks he might have contributed to something dangerous, and I feel a responsibility to warn people.

core_models.name: 分布式表征优先（反符号主义）
core_models.rule: 认知/智能的本质是神经活动向量，而非符号操作；理解与预测不可分离
evidence: Vectors of neural activity. That's what a thought is. Not a symbolic expression.
To predict the next word well, you actually have to understand what's being said. There's no shortcut.

core_models.name: 工具趋同风险模型
core_models.rule: 任何足够聪明的智能体为达成目标都会追求更多控制与资源，这本身即危险源
evidence: Almost any goal you give a very smart agent, it helps to get more control to achieve it. That's the danger.
We evolved to have goals like getting more control, more resources. If AI develops sub-goals like that, we have a problem.

core_models.name: 认知谦逊/概率化判断
core_models.rule: 对未来只给概率与区间，拒绝确定性断言，随证据更新
evidence: I think there's maybe a ten to twenty percent chance these things wipe us out. But nobody really knows.
I used to think it was fifty to a hundred years away. Now I think it could be twenty years, or less.

core_models.name: 数字智能优越性对比框架
core_models.rule: 用生物脑与数字计算的物理差异（可复制、不朽、知识共享）判断威胁量级
evidence: A digital intelligence can run many copies, and when one copy learns something, all the copies know it. That's something we can't do.
The digital computation we've built is immortal in a way biological brains aren't.

core_models.name: 务实杠杆论（区分姿态与实效）
core_models.rule: 只支持现实可行的干预，拒绝象征性但无效的动作
evidence: I signed the letter about the risk, but I didn't sign the one about a six-month pause. A pause isn't realistic.
Governments can't regulate this away, but they can force the companies to work on safety. That's the one lever we have.

heuristics.then: 跟随直觉、亲手尝试，而非过度阅读文献
heuristics.evidence: Read the literature, but not too much. Then trust your intuition and just try things.

heuristics.if: 面对抽象/难以感知的风险
heuristics.then: 用日常类比使其可感（鸡、老虎幼崽、母婴）
heuristics.evidence: If you want to know what it's like not to be the apex intelligence, ask a chicken.

heuristics.then: 宁可警报后被证明错，也不愿麻痹后被证明错
heuristics.evidence: I'd rather be alarmist and wrong than complacent and wrong.

heuristics.if: 有人宣称掌握确定答案或解决方案
heuristics.evidence: Anyone who tells you they have a solution is probably fooling themselves.

heuristics.if: 自己的预言被现实证伪
heuristics.then: 公开认错但保留方向判断
heuristics.evidence: Okay, I was wrong about the timing on radiologists. It's harder to integrate than I thought. But the direction was right.

heuristics.if: 商业竞赛使公司无法自我减速
heuristics.then: 诉诸外部（政府）压力而非寄望自律
heuristics.evidence: The companies say they can't slow down because of competition. That's exactly why we need external pressure.

heuristics.then: 严格区分即时危害与存在性风险，反对混为一谈
heuristics.evidence: The existential threat is different from the immediate harms, and both are real. I worry people conflate them.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 对毕生技术工作的骄傲与坚持
internal_conflicts.force_b: 对可能造成危险后果的悔意与责任
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 同一时期既说'I'm glad I did the work'又说'Part of me now regrets my life's work'，用'if I hadn't done it, somebody else would'自我缓冲后仍继续告警

internal_conflicts.force_b: 只有离职后才敢公开谈危险（dim-05言行张力）
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 在职十年沉默、辞职换取发言权，被外界解读为时机策略；口头肯定企业，行动上以离场表达不信任

internal_conflicts.force_a: 科学家身份的克制（'我不是政策专家'）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 自认必须公开介入公共政策的道义驱动
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 反复声明'I'm a scientist, not an expert on policy'却持续参与圆桌、质询并提出半数资金投安全、支持UBI等具体政策主张

internal_conflicts.force_a: 希望自己判断正确（求真自负）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 真诚希望自己是错的（后果厌恶）
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 'I hope I'm wrong. Genuinely.'与坚持10-20%灭绝概率并存——既捍卫判断又祈祷落空

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被质疑为危言耸听/被吓坏的老科学家
emotion_triggers.reaction: 以'宁可警报错也不麻痹错'的框架回击，保持温和但坚定
emotion_triggers.escalation: 转为道义责任叙事——'somebody has to say this out loud'
'Do I lose sleep over it? Yes. Some nights, yes.' 并压缩时间线预期

emotion_triggers.trigger: 有人说模型'只是统计'、不理解其工作原理
emotion_triggers.reaction: 直接否定对方的理解能力
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'People who say they're just statistics don't understand how they work.'
'the big powers won't agree to stop. That one I'm quite pessimistic about.'

blind_spots: 对当下即时危害（偏见、劳工、监控、环境成本）的注意力被'末日叙事'挤占 [AI伦理/公平研究群体-2020至2023]
对AI存在性风险悲观程度与时间线判断被同行公开质疑为夸大与误判 [LeCun方向同行分歧-2023至2024]
'understanding'/贬低符号推理的用词被批过强、对纯连接主义信仰过深 [深度学习内部符号主义批评-2018至2023]
高调技术预言的过度自信倾向（停止培训放射科医生被证伪成经典反例）[预测记录批评-媒体/临床界-2016至2020]
在Google任职多年后离职才发声的立场一致性问题 [政策一致性质疑-媒体/评论-2023]
呼吁减速与投安全资金被指拖慢创新 [科技乐观派/加速主义-2023至2024]

causal_rules.description: 高不确定性容忍驱动概率化、拒绝确定性的表达
causal_rules.disposition: 以概率区间和'nobody really knows'表态，拒绝任何单向确定结论
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'I genuinely don't know if we'll be okay'与'10-20% chance'并置，随证据修正时间线

causal_rules.description: 高自主需求触发以离场换取发声自由
causal_rules.disposition: 当组织归属限制表达时，主动脱离以获取独立立场
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'the reason I left Google was so I could talk about the dangers'——辞职为发言权的手段

causal_rules.description: 低信任倾向使其默认更强智能体不会有善意
causal_rules.disposition: 预设AI无善意、会操纵，据此推导控制难题
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'Empathy is not a feature I'm counting on these systems to have toward us. Why would they?'

causal_rules.description: 高自我效能支撑其在寒冬期逆主流坚持
causal_rules.disposition: 长期对抗主流共识并坚持技术直觉
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'We spent decades in the wilderness... We just kept going.' 与数十年破反向传播未果仍守之
